arguments.message: If a webhook was repointed to a domain you don’t control, that’s a security incident. First, go to **Settings → Developer → Webhooks** and disable or change the webhook back to a safe endpoint – this stops any further deliveries right away. Then open a support ticket so our security team can review when the change happened, which account made it, and what data may have been sent to the unauthorized domain. You can also view the full delivery history in **Settings → Developer → Webhooks → Delivery log** to see each attempt, status codes, and response bodies.
